overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: an email forwarded to a quorum largely memorialized views already expressed at the posted March 29 meeting, so it was not improper deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the then-Chair forwarded a former member's email expressing views on the superintendent hire to a quorum of the committee, deliberating outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Nonetheless, we find that the essence of her email had been conveyed during the posted meeting, and therefore Mr. Ryan’s distribution of the email to a quorum of the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
